question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 10.
solution:
The correct answer is 'nose.'

__
 
• In this passage, we are majorly talking about the disease **'cold'** and this disease is associated to the **nose**.
 
• इस passage में, हम प्रमुख रूप से **'cold'** रोग के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं और यह रोग **nose** से जुड़ा है।
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'nose.'
 
• The correct phrase: *....... **that affect the lining of the **nose** and the other passages leading to the lungs .....*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• As a personal pronoun (both subject and object), one can be used to refer to ‘people in general’.
 
• We often use one in making generalisations, especially in more formal styles.
 
 
• Example: *One never knows, does one?*
